results.name: rls_policy_always_true
results.title: RLS Policy Always True
results.description: Detects RLS policies that use overly permissive expressions like `USING (true)` or `WITH CHECK (true)` for UPDATE, DELETE, or INSERT operations. SELECT policies with `USING (true)` are intentionally excluded as this pattern is often used deliberately for public read access.
results.detail: Table `public.approval_logs` has an RLS policy `apl_insert` for `INSERT` that allows unrestricted access (WITH CHECK clause is always true). This effectively bypasses row-level security for authenticated.
